title: 汇丰资管Beth Wong：中国医疗保健被忽视，生物科技成新亮点
speaker: Beth Wong

segments.en: I mean, we're overweight on China, but as I said before, it's not just on tech. So one of the areas we think that is really getting quite interesting and has been neglected for the first half of the year is in the Chinese healthcare sector, especially on biotech.
segments.zh: 我们超配中国，但不仅仅是科技。我们认为上半年被忽视的一个领域是中国医疗保健，尤其是生物科技。

segments.en: I think just to put things in context, I think China has really evolved from the last few years to being like a low-cost research hub to really partnering with MNCs in terms of drug development and drug manufacturing.
segments.zh: 中国在过去几年已经从低成本研发中心转变为与跨国公司在药物研发和生产方面合作。

segments.en: So this is a very clear trend that we're seeing. And in our portfolios, we're, you know, for example, positive in some of the Chinese CDM players.
segments.zh: 这是我们看到的明显趋势。在我们的组合中，例如，我们对一些中国CDM企业持积极态度。
